== Biography ==
=== 2018 Season ===
Đỗ "'''DNK'''" Ngọc Khải joined [[Friends Forever Gaming]] as a jungler, late in the [[VCS/2018 Season/Spring Season|VCS Spring Season]], only playing two games before the end of the split. 

Despite only playing two games in Spring [[DNK]] became the main jungler in the [[VCS/2018 Season/Summer Season|VCS Summer Season]] sharing the role with [[Venus]] and [[Kriss]], bringing the team to a 2nd place finish with a 10-4 series score, DNK finished the split with a 18-9 game score.

DNK started in the first three games of a 3-1 loss to [[Cube Adonis]] in the [[VCS/2018 Season/Summer Playoffs| VCS 2018 Summer Playoffs]].

=== 2019 Season ===
In the [[VCS/2019 Season/Spring Season|VCS Spring Season]] DNK took full control of the jungle roles playing all 35 games of the teams 4th place finish.

In the [[VCS/2019 Season/Spring Playoffs| VCS 2019 Spring Playoffs]] [[EVOS Esports]] defeated [[Friends Forever Gaming|FFQ]] in 5 games.

With the introduction of [[Kaiz]] to the newly formed [[Lowkey Esports.Vietnam|Lowkey Esports]] it was thought that [[DNK]] would split time, however [[Kaiz]] would play just one of the teams 32 games from the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Season|VCS Summer Season]] where Lowkey would place 3rd with a 9-5 record.

In the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Playoffs|VCS 2019 Summer Playoffs]] Lowkey were chosen by [[GAM Esports]] and swept 3-0, in the Losers bracket Lowkey first faced [[Dashing Buffalo]] who they beat 3-0 and then [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]] where they won 3-1 to qualify for the [[2019 Season World Championship/Play-In|2019 World Championship Play-In]].

== Trivia ==
* Known for his ability to smite steal barons in [[VCS 2020 Spring]] and gained the nickname "The VCS's Prince of Thief "
